meaning:
κλίνη, -ης, ἡ
(κλίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִטָּה ;]
a bed, couch: Mat.9:2, 6, Mrk.4:21 7:4, 30, Luk.5:18 8:16 17:34, Rev.2:22 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven…
He said to them, “Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
